name: 86 Chaos 17.0.24
label: 86 Chaos 17.0.24
releaseTitle: App-Only Package Preflight and Installer Integrity Repair
notes: Adds a deep app-only package preflight before any repository mutation so forbidden generated artifacts cannot reach the installer stage.
Requires every packaged source file to be represented by the release source manifest and rejects generated, cache, build-identity, credential-like, log, archive, and test-result contamination.
Preserves reporter-agnostic Node 24 regression behavior and hermetic local regression isolation from 17.0.23 and 17.0.22.
title: 86 Chaos 17.0.24
summary: Makes app-only release packaging fail closed before repository mutation and enforces manifest-complete package contents.
description: Repairs the 17.0.23 packaging failure by adding a deep package preflight to the one-paste updater and strengthening installer validation so generated artifacts or unmanifested files cannot be installed. Production restaurant behavior is unchanged.
